 Valverde expected to miss Sunday’s match against Racing Santander
 by Lucas Navarrete Oct 31, 2026, 3:13 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Real Madrid defender Fede Valverde did not train with the group this Saturday and therefore will be expected to miss Sunday’s away match in Santander against Racing. Valverde played through a minor muscle injury in El Clásico and Madrid’s coaching staff decided to take a cautious approach with him during the rest of the week.
 On the other hand, Arda Güler rejoined the squad in training and should be ready to face Racing, although Mourinho could very well decide to make some more rotations.
 Los Blancos will need to capitalize on the momentum and confidence they built with their impressive victory over Barcelona, and even if Mourinho decides to give some starters the opportunity to rest, Madrid should be considered the heavy favorites to earn the three points on Sunday.
